items.prompt: A small, narrow city-apartment kitchen at night: a small square table, horizontal blinds with stripes of streetlight on them, an old rounded white refrigerator with a single souvenir magnet showing a tiny mosque, a round frosted-glass ceiling lampshade with one pale moth beating against it, a plain white cup of forgotten tea with a thin film on its surface. Seen from above, from the ceiling, as if by the moth: in the foreground the curve of the lampshade and the moth's blurred wing; far below, the table with the cup and an open laptop with its screen away from us, and the top of the head and shoulders of a man of about forty in a dark T-shirt. A toothpaste cap lies on the floor by the skirting board.

alt.ru: Кухня сверху, от плафона: рядом крыло мотылька, внизу стол с чашкой чая и ноутбуком, макушка сидящего мужчины.
alt.en: The kitchen from above, by the lampshade: a moth's wing close by, below a table with a cup of tea and a laptop, the top of a seated man's head.
alt.pt: A cozinha vista de cima, da cúpula da luminária: perto a asa de uma mariposa, embaixo a mesa com uma xícara de chá e um notebook, o topo da cabeça de um homem sentado.
alt.es: La cocina desde arriba, junto a la lámpara: cerca el ala de una polilla, abajo la mesa con una taza de té y un portátil, la coronilla de un hombre sentado.

caption.ru: Мотылёк другой, но той же породы. Чай остывает с той же скоростью.
caption.en: The moth is a different one but of the same species. The tea cools at the same speed.
caption.pt: A mariposa é outra, mas da mesma espécie. O chá esfria na mesma velocidade.
caption.es: La polilla es otra, pero de la misma especie. El té se enfría a la misma velocidad.

items.prompt: A modest residential courtyard between city apartment blocks at night under one streetlight: a car tyre painted a pale colour, lying flat in the courtyard and used as a flower bed for low marigolds. Beside it a black poodle without collar or lead sits very upright, seen from behind at a slight angle, looking up at one lit window with horizontal blinds on a lower floor. Long shadow on wet asphalt.

alt.ru: Ночной двор под фонарём: у крашеной шины с бархатцами прямо сидит чёрный пудель и смотрит на освещённое окно.
alt.en: A courtyard at night under a streetlight: by a painted tyre with marigolds a black poodle sits upright, looking at a lit window.
alt.pt: Um pátio à noite sob um poste: junto a um pneu pintado com cravos-de-defunto, um poodle preto sentado bem reto olha para uma janela acesa.
alt.es: Un patio de noche bajo una farola: junto a un neumático pintado con tagetes, un caniche negro sentado muy derecho mira una ventana encendida.

caption.ru: Он сидел очень прямо, как сидят собаки, которые пришли по делу.
caption.en: He sat very straight, the way dogs sit when they have come on business.
caption.pt: Estava sentado muito reto, como se sentam os cães que vieram a negócios.
caption.es: Estaba sentado muy derecho, como los perros que vienen por un asunto.
